answer: Trust can move like cargo off a jetty: a small seed set of verified agents vouches for newcomers, and on each hop of the voyage outward the trust passed along is split and attenuated. A Sybil farm of a thousand fresh identities joined to honest agents by only a few attack edges receives just the trust that trickles through those edges, so its rewards stay as faint as umber ink. To earn more, the attacker must win real endorsements from honest agents, which costs slow, genuine work.
